title: Korobeiniki (Korobushka)
attribution: Words from Nikolay Nekrasov's poem "Korobeiniki" (1861; Nekrasov died in 1878), sung to an anonymous Russian folk tune that was in print by 1898 (arranged by Yakov Prigozhy, who died in 1920); both are public domain. This is the tune as sung, taken from a Russian vocal score with Nekrasov's words; the version known from the game Tetris differs slightly in the first bar. The last two lines are repeated, as is usual.
